name: Nanobots3
title: Nanobots: Early Bots 3.0
author: Nexela (original), AI-improved
description: Personal construction nanobots: build, repair, upgrade, clear trees and rocks, and supply turret ammunition without a roboport network. Features quality support, vehicle and cargo-wagon materials, construction around your character during remote view, configurable work modes, combat automation, and statistics. Space Age compatible.
